stem: The function \(f\) is defined by \(f(x) = 3^{x}\). In the \(xy\)-plane, the graph of \(y = g(x)\) is the graph of \(y = f(x)\) shifted 2 units to the right. Which of the following defines \(g\)?
solution: Shifting a graph \(h\) units to the right replaces \(x\) with \(x - h\): \(g(x) = f(x - 2)\).

explanation.A: Incorrect. Replacing \(x\) with \(x + 2\) shifts the graph 2 units to the left.
explanation.B: Incorrect. Subtracting \(2\) from the output shifts the graph 2 units down, not to the right.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Adding \(2\) to the output shifts the graph 2 units up.

verify:
x = symbols('x')
rhs = {k: value(v.split('=')[1]) for k, v in choices.items()}
ok = [k for k in rhs if simplify(rhs[k] - 3**(x - 2)) == 0]
assert ok == [answer]
